reason: S1 adds the public stream_format::comma_delimited_array mode and mode-specific outer-array processing, but H0 never selects that format. fuzz_ndjson.cpp calls parser.parse_many(json,batch_size), which uses the default whitespace_delimited format, while fuzz_ondemand.cpp calls parser.iterate(padded) rather than iterate_many. Thus H0 cannot exercise the new format-selection protocol or control inputs for its bracket validation, JSON-whitespace stripping, and comma-delimited element iteration. This gap did not exist for comma_delimited_array in S0 because that enum value and both associated branches were introduced by S1.
evidence: simdjson::dom::parser::parse_many branches on format == stream_format::comma_delimited_array, strips JSON whitespace and outer '[' and ']', returns TAPE_ERROR for invalid framing, and then assigns format = stream_format::comma_delimited.
simdjson::ondemand::parser::iterate_many adds the corresponding comma_delimited_array branch.
fuzz/fuzz_ndjson.cpp invokes parser.parse_many(json,batch_size) without a stream_format argument.
fuzz/fuzz_ondemand.cpp invokes parser.iterate(padded) and contains no iterate_many or stream_format selection.
recommended_action: Extend a streaming harness to derive a stream_format from fuzz input and invoke both dom::parser::parse_many and ondemand::parser::iterate_many with stream_format::comma_delimited_array, preserving independent control over batch_size and the framed array bytes.
